data_policy: Leaf image is never sent to model server
limitations: PlantVillage model dataset does not cover all farm crops
Unrelated pictures and unseen diseases can be misclassified even at high model scores
Scores are not calibrated agronomic confidence
Requires first-time internet and browser cache for offline reuse
No field validation performed here; professional confirmation required before treatment
runtime_reason: Use non-quantized model.onnx to avoid ONNX Runtime Web WASM unsupported ConvInteger operator in q8 graph

crop_first_analysis.strategy: Request all 38 disease classes using documented top_k:0, aggregate candidate crop evidence, allow farmer to verify or correct vegetable and then restrict disease suggestions to that crop.
crop_first_analysis.unsupported: Do not predict crop-specific diseases for lettuce, onion, cucumber, basil, pak choi, cabbage, carrot, eggplant or other absent labels.
crop_first_analysis.note: Crop confidence is not separately calibrated; explicit farmer crop selection is not independent AI verification. Accuracy improvement is unmeasured until evaluated on real images.

inference_fallback: retry top 5 classes when all-class ranking fails
field_validation: not verified: browser source access and real-image performance depend on runtime and network
